title: Here’s Where to Get Last-Minute LE SSERAFIM Tickets Online for 2026 PUREFLOW World Tour
summary: The K-pop sensation kicks off the North American leg of their trek on Sept. 16 in Los Angeles.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

LE SSERAFIM “Need Your Company.” The band is bringing its 2026 PUREFLOW world tour across North America after kicking off the global trek on July 11 in Incheon, South Korea. The tour supports the group’s second studio album, PUREFLOW Pt. 1 , which arrived in May with 11 tracks including “Celebration,” “Boompala” and “Saki.”

The North American dates are now underway, with the Los Angeles show taking place Sept. 16 before stops in Tacoma, Wash.; San Jose, Calif.; Phoenix; Fort Worth, Texas; Orlando, Fla.; Chicago; Washington, D.C.; and Newark, N.J. With venues filling up and tickets going fast, only a limited number remain for several cities. Fans can still find tickets for the North American tour on Ticketmaster , StubHub , SeatGeek and Vivid Seats . Parking passes for all venues are also available to purchase separately through each ticketing platform.

shop le Sserafim tour tickets at ticketmaster

LE SSERAFIM is the sole act on the bill for the North American dates of its 2026 PUREFLOW world tour, giving fans a full evening centered on the group. The tour launched in Incheon with a 24-song set that ran for roughly two and a half hours, featuring performances from across the group’s catalog alongside songs from PUREFLOW Pt. 1 .

Fans can expect a high-energy production built around the group’s choreography and vocals, with the set moving between upbeat performances and more stripped-back moments. With the North American leg stopping in cities including Los Angeles, Phoenix, Chicago AND Washington, D.C.A, fans have several opportunities to catch the group live.

Where to Find LE SSERAFIM Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find LE SSERAFIM Tickets at StubHub

Buy tickets here

StubHub is a peer-to-peer ticket marketplace where fans and ticket brokers can list seats for concerts, sports and other live events. Because it operates as a resale market, sellers set their own prices, meaning listings can cost more or less than the original face value. StubHub says its FanProtect Guarantee helps ensure buyers receive valid tickets for their event. As of publication, LE SSERAFIM tickets start at $76.

BEST PRICES

Find LE SSERAFIM Tickets at SeatGeek

SeatGeek combines primary ticket sales with a secondary marketplace where fans can buy and resell tickets. Its Buyer Guarantee covers eligible purchases, promising valid entry and ticket delivery before the event. The platform also uses its Deal Score system to help shoppers compare listings based on factors including price and seat location. As of publication, LE SSERAFIM tickets start at $73, with most available options priced below $100.

DISCOUNTS FOR APPLICABLE CUSTOMERS

Find LE SSERAFIM Tickets at Vivid Seats

Vivid Seats is a secondary ticket marketplace connecting buyers with independent sellers, including individual fans and professional ticket brokers. Its 100% Buyer Guarantee covers ticket authenticity, timely delivery and valid entry, with refunds available if those promises are not met. The platform also offers a 10% discount to military personnel, first responders, medical providers, nurses, teachers and students. Verification is required on their website via ID.me to secure the discount. As of publication, LE SSERAFIM tickets start at $73.

CONCERT ESSENTIAL

Lightsticks are an essential accessory at K-pop concerts, where fans can be part of the performance through a synced light show with changing colors depending on the song. The official LE SSERAFIM lightstick includes a package box, lightstick, strap, dust bag and manual. Make sure to set up the lightstick by connecting it to the official mobile app while at home, so that it’s ready in time for the concert.
